
## Install

1. Download `Laser-Check-…-macOS.zip` below and open it.
2. Double-click **Install Laser Check.command**. If macOS says it can't check it for malware, right-click it, choose **Open**, then **Open** again.
3. Allow access to Downloads when asked.

That puts **Laser Check** in `~/Applications` and starts the watcher at login. Works on Apple silicon and Intel, macOS 13 or later.
